h:
使用 It 的简单工作流程剑圣 XL 闪电也可以更改为与其他 SDXL 型号配合使用。

在此工作流程中，您有一个 Lora 堆栈加载器、一个放大器和一些高级面部细节器。

如果加载工作流程时出现任何错误（缺少节点），请转到 comfyui 管理器并单击“安装缺少的自定义节点”。

o.en:
A simple workflow to use with ItJuggernaut XL Lightningcan also be changed to work with others SDXL models as well.

In this workflow, you have a Lora stack loader, an upscaler, and a little bit of an advanced face detailer.

If you have any error on loading the workflow (missing nodes) go on comfyui manager and click "Install Missing Custom Nodes".
